resources.string: Lets NexusAgent read the screen and perform taps on your behalf

NexusAgent uses this service to read the layout of whatever app is on screen and to perform taps, typing, and swipes for you, so it can carry out spoken instructions like \"set an alarm for 6am\".\n\nScreen contents are only read while a task is actively running, and you can stop a task at any time from the floating control bubble.
